data.turoyo: Bas komətḥayafno, d gədəzzeyo qafle rabṯo, gədməbli ʕam ruḥayye, gədsaymila 'oṯurayto'.
data.translation: But I very much regret that a large group will go, they will take it with them, they will make it 'Assyrian.'

rationale: Second Infectum example: anticipatory regret with a content clause, no overt ʕal target. English is verbatim project machine translation; semantic analysis rests on Turoyo.

data.turoyo: Komətḥayafno aʕlayye, d ṭorən Faṭəryarxo Yaʕqub, u babo du tarix, u babo du ʕələm. W d əzze hən bəṯre ḥasyo Šaliṭa, d kətwa aṯməl, d kətwa aṯməl bi Dayro du Zaḥfaran talmiḏo.
data.translation: I very much regret for them that they leave Patriarch Jacob, the father of history, the father of learning, and that some follow Bishop Shalita, who was yesterday, who was yesterday a pupil at the Saffron Monastery.

rationale: Third Infectum example: ʕal target plus coordinated content clauses in a political/religious assessment. English is verbatim project machine translation; semantic analysis rests on Turoyo.
